headline: UK Inflation Accelerates to 10-Month High of 3.5% on Surcharging Fuel Costs
summary: The United Kingdom's annual inflation rate climbed to 3.5% in September from 3.1% in August, driven by a surge in fuel prices and exceeding analyst expectations.
why: Inflation metrics directly dictate central bank monetary policy and interest rate decisions, which influence borrowing costs, currency values, and equity market valuations.
